name: Khyati Multimedia Entertainment Ltd

keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]

- Desktop publishing and imaging
- Corporate presentations and advertisements
- Creative and graphic designing
- Multimedia software development

Vehicle leasing and rental services
c) Additional ventures:
- Sports entertainment sponsorship
- Digital media marketing at state and district levels

cons: Stock is trading at 3.30 times its book value
